title: Logging by category

milestone.title: Visual Studio and the Build Pipeline

description:
Log messages with a level and a category, and choose at run time which to show.

```
enabled: render=warn, ai=debug
[ai][debug] goblin picked target 3
[render][warn] texture missing, using a placeholder
(render debug messages hidden)
```
hints: A category missing from the map uses a default level, such as `info` (lesson 4.07).
Wrap the check and the print in the macro so the arguments are not even evaluated when hidden.
requirements: Levels debug, info, warn, error; a map from category to its minimum level.
A `LOG(category, level, ...)` macro that skips formatting when the message is hidden.
Messages go to a file and to the debugger output (`OutputDebugStringA`, simulated with `std::cerr` here).
stretch: Change the levels from a debug console command while the game runs.
